claims.text: The buyer is seeking approximately 1 ton (1000 kg) of scrap titanium nets.
The buyer is interested in various forms of scrap titanium netting, including industrial titanium mesh/screening used in filtration, chemical processing, or aerospace applications.
Damaged or offcut titanium nets are acceptable, regardless of size or shape, as long as they are primarily titanium.
Titanium alloy nets are also acceptable.
Suppliers must be able to provide documentation regarding the material’s origin and composition, if possible.
The buyer is seeking suppliers located in Nigeria and China.
Shipping arrangements from other locations are open for discussion.
Pricing will be negotiated based on the material’s purity, quantity, and condition.

Interested suppliers should provide detailed information about available scrap titanium nets, including quantity, material composition, condition, location, photographs (if available), and quoted price.
